name: Relation Set Metrics (PGM)
process:
calculator = get_plugin('MetricsCalculation')
entities = state.get('entity_aliases') or state.get('entities') or state.get('filtered_entities')
expected_raw = state.get('ground_truth') or state.get('gold_relations') or ''
predicted_raw = state.get('relations') or []
if not str(expected_raw or '').strip():
    __result__ = {}
else:
    expected_raw = calculator.normalize_cid_lines(expected_raw, entities)
    predicted_raw = calculator.normalize_cid_lines(predicted_raw, entities)
    expected = calculator.parse_relation_pairs(expected_raw)
    predicted = calculator.parse_relation_pairs(predicted_raw)
    __result__ = calculator.calculate(expected, predicted)
description: Evaluates chemical–induced-disease relation sets by normalizing and comparing predicted relations to ground truth.
